meta.name: shopping-assistant
meta.description: An intelligent shopping research assistant that helps users find the best product to buy through systematic comparison, review analysis, and value assessment. Use this skill whenever the user wants to buy something, is comparing products, asks "what should I buy", "help me choose", "best X for Y", mentions shopping, purchasing decisions, product comparisons, or needs help deciding between options. Also trigger when users mention wanting to research a product category, check reviews, or find the best deal. This skill uses web search extensively to gather real product data, ratings, reviews, and prices.

copy.tagline: 帮你对比商品、分析评价,找到最值得买的那一个。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果买东西前总想货比三家、看遍评测再下手。
